_note: Data for scripts/check-first-paint.mjs. cls.limit is the target; a page fails above max(limit, baseline + tolerance). Fixes ratchet baselines down with --update-baseline. lateCssAllowlist entries are {site, page, handle, reason}; handle is the stylesheet's id attribute (or 'inline#N' for an unnamed <style>).

lateCssAllowlist.reason: Third-party payment plugin stylesheet for the express-payment buttons, enqueued by that plugin in wp_footer; it styles only its own lazily mounted payment element, which is below the first viewport.
